d:
For more than 10–15 years, I’ve been working on ideas that I believe could make a real difference to India.
Today, I’m revealing **PROJECT .**
What if every Indian citizen could receive a FREE basic health checkup from the government once every year — on their birthday?
The idea is simple:
Your birthday → Your annual health checkup → Early detection → A healthier India
Many people don't think about getting regular health checkups until they feel sick. By then, a health problem may already have progressed significantly.
